instruction: Using these images as the exact style and design reference (same chibi knight, same thick dark outlines, same flat two-tone cel shading, same blue-and-silver plate armour, same colours), draw ONLY ONE game-art part for 2D cutout animation, alone, centred, whole and complete with a closed outline all round, large and filling most of the image height. Transparent background, nothing else in the image, no shadow, no text. The part: a black leather gauntlet fist gripping a longsword: the fist at the bottom of the image with its cuff at the very bottom, the sword pointing straight up out of the fist, crossguard just above the fist, the pommel just below the fist
